caption: The drawing features the head and upper chest of a person, rendered with minimal and delicate pencil lines on a plain, light-colored background. The hair is prominently detailed in shades of brown, styled in large, rounded, and segmented rolls that frame the head symmetrically, both on the sides and the top. The face is outlined but lacks detailed features, except for faintly indicated eyebrows, eyes, and the outline of the nose and mouth. Around the neck, there is a loosely sketched, ruffled collar or scarf, depicted using thin lines and a scalloped edge. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small secondary sketch of the back of a head and neck, also showing an intricate hairstyle, but rendered only in pencil without any color. The overall composition centers the main figure's head, with the additional hairstyle detail positioned to the lower right.
title: Headdress
